newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Virgin Atlantic to link with S.Africa's Sun Air.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Atlantic to link with S.Africa's Sun Air.

text.p: Richard Branson's Virgin Atlantic Airways plans to tie-up with Sun Air, a South African airline which the government has earmarked for privatisation, industry sources said on Thursday.
Details of the deal are expected to be announced by Branson, currently on a visit to South Africa, either later on Thursday or Friday, the sources said.
They declined to say what was involved in the agreement, although Virgin is not expected to take an equity stake in Sun Air -- at least at this stage.
Virgin is to start direct Johannesburg-to-London flights on October 3, starting with three flights a week and increasing to six next year. The company also hopes to launch package holidays in 1997.
A link with Sun Air would increase Virgin's reach within South Africa.
South Africa's largest independent carrier, Comair, signed a franchise agreement with British Airways Plc in June under which its aircraft will use the BA name and livery.
